name: Academy Glintstone Key
notes: HAS TWO VERSIONS, one for Thops that does nothing and another one that allows the player to enter Raya Lucaria. (Last part of description starts with "A Glintstone Key will remember its user."

name: Carian Inverted Statue
notes: Used to progress in Carian Study Hall and reach the Divine Tower of Liurnia.

name: Cursemark of Death
notes: Used to access the Deathbed Dream in Deeproot Depths. (Note that the fight itself is missable and cannot have key items.)

name: Dark Moon Ring
notes: Used to progress to Moonlight Altar from Ainsel River. Can optionally be used to do the final step of Ranni's quest and unlock her ending, but leads to no additional critical items.

name: Dectus Medallion (Left)
notes: Used to ascend the Grand Lift of Dectus. Other routes to enter Altus Plateau are also possible.

name: Dectus Medallion (Right)
notes: Used to ascend the Grand Lift of Dectus. Other routes to enter Altus Plateau are also possible.

name: Discarded Palace Key
notes: Used to unlock the treasure chest in the Raya Lucaria Grand Library.

name: Drawing-Room Key
notes: Used to access the Volcano Manor Drawing Room and the lava area hidden within. Required if planning to do Deathless without going through the Raya Lucaria shortcut.

name: Great Runes
notes: Do not count Miquella's Great Rune

name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Left)
notes: Used to access Consecrated Snowfield, the hidden path to the Haligtree.

name: Haligtree Secret Medallion (Right)
notes: Used to access Consecrated Snowfield, the hidden path to the Haligtree. This part can also be used to optionally progress Latenna's quest.

name: Imbued Sword Key
notes: Used to unlock a Sending Gate at the Four Belfries in Liurnia. There are three of these in the game, but only one is mandatory for the Precipice of Anticipation important location.

name: Pureblood Knight's Medal
notes: Used to immediately access Mohgwyn Palace without using the Sending Gate in Consecrated Snowfield.

name: Rold Medallion
notes: Used to access Mountaintops of the Giants after Leyndell. With modified rulesets, it can be replaced with a Great Runes requirement.

name: Rusty Key
notes: Used to progress into Stormveil Castle. This is optional, unless Gostoc dies before he opens the main gate for you.

name: Stonesword Key
notes: Set this to the keys you are holding now, and lower it when you spend them. Imp seals use keys up, including seals this tracker does not list. Spending your last keys locks an unchecked location behind that seal again, but you can still check it off. Not part of the original checklist's logic.

name: Messmer's Kindling
notes: Used to burn the Sealing Tree in Rauh Ruins. With modified rulesets, this can be split into some number of Messmer's Kindling Shards with a minimum shard count required to burn the Sealing Tree.

name: Messmer's Kindling Shards
notes: Used to burn the Sealing Tree in Rauh Ruins. With modified rulesets, this can be split into some number of Messmer's Kindling Shards with a minimum shard count required to burn the Sealing Tree.

name: O Mother
notes: Used to access Hinterland by using the gesture in front of the Marika statue behind Shadow Keep.

name: Hole-Laden Necklace
notes: Used at Finger Ruins to progress Count Ymir's quest and access the Metyr boss fight.

name: Well Depths Key
notes: Used to access the Belurat swamp.

name: Gaol Upper Level Key
notes: Required to fully traverse Lamenter's Gaol if "Randomise Lamenter's Gaol Keys" is enabled.

name: Gaol Lower Level Key
notes: Required to fully traverse Lamenter's Gaol if "Randomise Lamenter's Gaol Keys" is enabled.

name: Lord of Blood's Favor
notes: Can be used on one of the three possible maidens, and can be used to progress Varrés quest after having obtained at least one Great Rune. Only leads you to the Varré invasion.

name: Sewing Needle
notes: Can only be used to move Boc's quest forward, leads no nothing else of importance.

name: Sellian Sealbreaker
notes: Used to free Master Lusat and progress Sellen's quest, but is otherwise completely optional and leads to no shortcuts.

name: Sellen's Primal Glintstone
notes: Used to progress Sellen's quest, but is otherwise completely optional and leads to no shortcuts.

name: Irina's Letter
notes: Can be used to progress Edgar's Quest, but completely optional and leads to no shortcuts.

name: Chrysalid's Memento
notes: Can be used to get an extra item drop in Stormveil Castle that can't spawn any critical items. Also easily missed if Chrysalid's Memento spawns in an area that makes Roderika move to the Roundtable Hold.

name: Alexander's Innard
notes: Used for the Jar-Barin quest, but completely optional and leads to no shortcuts.

name: Weathered Dagger
notes: Used to progress Fia's quest, can be used to enter Leyndell through Deeproot Depths and bypass any possible greatrune requirements.

name: Twinned Helm
notes: All four parts can be used to iniate the last step of D's and Fia's quest, but only leads to an optional extra item drop.

name: Twinned Armor
notes: All four parts can be used to iniate the last step of D's and Fia's quest, but only leads to an optional extra item drop.

name: Twinned Gauntlets
notes: All four parts can be used to iniate the last step of D's and Fia's quest, but only leads to an optional extra item drop.

name: Twinned Greaves
notes: All four parts can be used to iniate the last step of D's and Fia's quest, but only leads to an optional extra item drop.

name: Deathroot
notes: Can be used to progress Gurrang's questline, but only leads to additional non-critical item drops.

name: Seluvis' Potion
notes: Can be used to end Nepheli Loux's or Dung Eater questline early and grant an additional sale option for Seluvis and must be done before giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade.

name: Seluvis' Introduction
notes: Optional item to give to Sellen, but only leads to some extra lore.

name: Fingerslayer Blade
notes: Can be given to Ranni to open Renna's Rise, allowing for an alternate route to Moonlight Altar, which would otherwise require you to go through Deeproot Depths.

name: Miniature Ranni
notes: Can only lead to an additional non-critical item drop when talked to before defeating Baleful Shadow, but otherwise completely optional.

name: Mending Rune of the Death-Prince
notes: Can be used to trigger a specific ending when not under the influence of the Frenzied Flame. Completely optional.

name: Mending Rune of Perfect Order
notes: Can be used to trigger a specific ending when not under the influence of the Frenzied Flame. Completely optional.

name: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
notes: Can be used to trigger a specific ending when not under the influence of the Frenzied Flame. Completely optional.

name: Stormhawk King
notes: Can be given to Nepheli for an additional non-critical item drop later, but otherwise completely optional.

name: Rya's Necklace
notes: Can be used to get an optional item drop from Rya if found before she moves to Volcano Manor. Also can be used as an optional shortcut to Volcano Manor when you run into her at Altus Plateau after giving it to her in Liurnia. (Near Lux Ruins or top of the Grand Lift of Dectus)

name: Sewer-Gaol Key
notes: Required for Dung Eater's quest progression, but leads to no shortcuts or critical items.

name: Seedbed Curse
notes: Five can be given to the Dungeater for some optional, non-critical items. Only after having acquired the Sewer-Gaol Key.

name: Law of Regression
notes: Can be used west of Erdtree Sanctuary to get more additional non-critical item drops in the Goldmask and Corhyn questline.

name: Glintstone Key
notes: Specifically Thops key, the one that doesn't allow you to enter Raya Lucaria. Grants an additional non-critical item spawn later.

name: Shabriri Grape
notes: Can be given to Hyetta to progress her questline and grant you an additional non-critical item drop after embracing the Frenzied Flame.

name: Latenna the Albinauric
notes: Used for one additional non-critical item drop at Apostate Derilict Church.

name: Volcano Manor Invitation
notes: Can be used as an optional shortcut to Volcano Manor when you run into Rya at Altus Plateau. (Near Lux Ruins or top of the Grand Lift of Dectus)(Might need to have given Rya's Necklace as well previously, confirmation needed) (So far worked with just the necklace, didnt have invitation, might still work with just invitation? idk)

name: Tonic of Forgetfullness
notes: Optional item in Rya's questline for an optional non-critical item drop.

name: Unalloyed Gold Needle
notes: Used for Millicent's questline, this line is fully optional and only leads to non-critical items and no shortcuts.

name: Valkyrie's Prosthetic
notes: Used for Millicent's questline, this line is fully optional and only leads to non-critical items and no shortcuts.

name: Millicent's Needle
notes: Used for Millicent's questline, this line is fully optional and only leads to non-critical items and no shortcuts.

name: Letter from Volcano Manor (Istvan)
notes: Required to unlock the invasion missions for Volcano Manor. Collect and execute all three, and unlock an alternate route to Rykard's fight.

name: Letter from Volcano Manor (Rileigh)
notes: Required to unlock the invasion missions for Volcano Manor. Collect and execute all three, and unlock an alternate route to Rykard's fight.

name: Red Letter
notes: Required to unlock the invasion missions for Volcano Manor. Collect and execute all three, and unlock an alternate route to Rykard's fight.

name: Letter to Patches
notes: Unlocks an optional invasion for Volcano Manor, but is completely optional and unlocks no alternate routes.

name: Dragon Heart
notes: Used to purchase items from the Dragon Communion altars, but those never house critical items. Could still possibly sell items required for optional shortcuts.
